csv_project_name: Design and Construct for HNS Roadway & Culverts 189485
csv_agency: St of AK DOT & Pub Facilities - Southcoast Region
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Alaska, Department of Transportation and Public Facilities may be seeking a consultant to provide design services and construct permanent repairs (PR) to assets damaged by the December 2020 Storm in the Southcoast Region of Alaska for Damage Inventory Numbers 461220 - 461221, 461229, 461231 - 461236, 461253, 461255 - 461257, 461652, 784622, and 918887 - 918890. Repairs may include, but are not limited to, asphalt, embankment, geotextile, riprap, drainage, roadside hardware, retaining walls, and utilities. This project will repair sites on Beach Road, Front Street, Allen-Menaker Road, Comstock Road, Piedad Road and Mud Bay Road.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
csv_comments: '* * * ADVANCE NOTICE * * *- Project No: SDRER00445- The RFQ/RFP package is expected to be available prior to 06/01/2027- Contract value: $2.5M-$5.0M- IMS requests NO PHONE CALLS, NO FAXES, and NO CONTACT with agency at this time.
title: Design and Construct for HNS Roadway & Culverts 189485
short_description: Design-build permanent storm damage repairs for roads, culverts, drainage, and retaining structures.
project_scope: Permanent repairs to transportation assets damaged by the December 2020 storm in the Southcoast Region of Alaska. Affected sites include Beach Road, Front Street, Allen-Menaker Road, Comstock Road, Piedad Road, and Mud Bay Road in Haines. Repair elements may include asphalt pavement, embankment reconstruction, geotextile, riprap, drainage works, roadside hardware, retaining walls, utilities, and culvert-related roadway repairs. Damage Inventory Numbers: 461220-461221, 461229, 461231-461236, 461253, 461255-461257, 461652, 784622, 918887-918890.
services: Design-build services including civil engineering design and construction for roadway and culvert repairs; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, utility engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roadway and culvert repair project, not a bridge or long-span structural project.
- Scope focuses on civil infrastructure rehabilitation such as asphalt, embankments, drainage, riprap, and utilities.
- Includes retaining walls, which add some structural content, but no notable spans or architecturally demanding structures are described.
- Design-build format offers some planning component, but the technical profile is outside sbp's core focus.
- Overall only limited relevance for sbp compared with bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure opportunities.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender notice stating a contract value range of $2.5M-$5.0M; midpoint used as a plain-number estimate in USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. The notice only gives an overall design-build contract value range of $2.5M-$5.0M, so a reliable sbp fee cannot be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: No specific bidder references or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice. Requested disciplines are design-build/developer, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, utility engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.
contracting_authority: State of Alaska, Department of Transportation and Public Facilities, Southcoast Region; Haines, Alaska, USA; website: https://dot.alaska.gov/procurement/awp/awp-tas.cfm
notes: Advance notice only. Project No. SDRER00445. RFQ/RFP package expected before 06/01/2027. IMS note: no phone calls, no faxes, and no contact with agency at this time. Although categorized here under Road Bridges due to the fixed output categories, the described scope is mainly roadway and culvert repair rather than a bridge project.
